page.overview:
Who is Alguff the Awful?

Alguff the Awful was a goblin who was known for being particularly foul-smelling. He was well-known throughout the goblin community for attempting to sell vials of his own sweat to a Dungbomb maker. For this, he was featured on a Chocolate Frog Card.
